'''Ruler Seven''' was a member of the [[Ruling Power]], the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. Along with [[Ruler Three]] and [[Ruler Six]], Ruler Seven led a hearing held to discuss accusations by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that [[Euceron (species)|Euceron]] hero [[Maxo Vista]] was guilty of murder and that Vista and [[Liviani Sarno]], head of the [[Games Council]] were conspiring to disgrace [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in an attempt to gain personal wealth. During the hearing, Ruler Seven argued that part of Kenobi's evidence was invalid because it relied on testimony from [[Bog Divian]], who had since contradicted his own testimony.<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
